title.zh: 将索索贡省 Bacon 市镇的 Rawis 国立中学附属校分离，改设为独立的 Rawis 国立中学，并为此拨款
title.en: An Act Separating the Rawis National High School Annex in the Municipality of Bacon, Province of Sorsogon, From the Sorsogon National High School (Snhs) in the Municipality of Sorsogon, and Converting It Into An Independent National High School To Be Known As the Rawis National High School, and Appropriating Funds Therefore
title.orig: An Act Separating the Rawis National High School Annex in the Municipality of Bacon, Province of Sorsogon, From the Sorsogon National High School (Snhs) in the Municipality of Sorsogon, and Converting It Into An Independent National High School To Be Known As the Rawis National High School, and Appropriating Funds Therefore
title.vi: Đạo luật tách Phân hiệu của Trường Trung học Rawis Quốc gia tại Đô thị Bacon, Tỉnh Sorsogon khỏi Trường Trung học Sorsogon Quốc gia và chuyển thành Trường Trung học Độc lập Quốc gia với tên gọi Trường Trung học Rawis Quốc gia, và bố trí kinh phí
title.th: พระราชบัญญัติแยกวิทยาเขตของโรงเรียนมัธยมศึกษา Rawis แห่งชาติในเทศบาล Bacon จังหวัด Sorsogon ออกจากโรงเรียนมัธยมศึกษา Sorsogon แห่งชาติและยกฐานะเป็นโรงเรียนมัธยมศึกษาเอกเทศแห่งชาติชื่อโรงเรียนมัธยมศึกษา Rawis แห่งชาติ และจัดสรรงบประมาณ
title.id: Undang-Undang Memisahkan Kampus, Sekolah Menengah Rawis Nasional di Kotamadya Bacon, Provinsi Sorsogon dari Sekolah Menengah Sorsogon Nasional dan menjadi Sekolah Menengah Mandiri Nasional dengan nama Sekolah Menengah Rawis Nasional, dan mengalokasikan dana
title.ms: Akta Memisahkan Kampus, Sekolah Menengah Rawis Kebangsaan di Perbandaran Bacon, Wilayah Sorsogon daripada Sekolah Menengah Sorsogon Kebangsaan dan menjadi Sekolah Menengah Bebas Kebangsaan dengan nama Sekolah Menengah Rawis Kebangsaan, dan memperuntukkan dana

text.en: The Rawis National High School Annex in Barangay Rawis in the Municipality of Bacon, Province of Sorsogon, is hereby separated from the Sorsogon National High School in the Municipality of Sorsogon, and converted into an independent national high school to be known as the Rawis National High School.
The Department of Education, Culture and Sports (DECS) shall issue such rules and regulations as may be necessary to carry out the provisions of this Act.
All personnel, assets, liabilities, and records of the Rawis National High School Annex are hereby transferred to and absorbed by the Rawis National High School.
The amount necessary to carry out the provisions of this Act shall be included in the General Appropriations Act of the year following its enactment into law and thereafter.
This Act shall take effect upon its approval.
